title: Design System: Brent & Denise — Retiring Abroad

display.purpose: Page and post titles. Uppercase Archivo at 800.

label.purpose: Nav, buttons, filters, dates, metadata. Uppercase Archivo at 600.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover, border, and color changes on controls.

motion.name: route-draw
motion.purpose: The single authored moment: the hero route profile draws once on load; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action: read the story, subscribe, send.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 24px; background: var(--color-accent); border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--color-bg); font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-strong); border-color: var(--color-accent-strong); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The quieter action beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 24px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--color-accent); font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-bg); }

components.name: Tag Filter
components.description: Blog filter chip; the active state inverts to the accent fill.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-tag:hover { color: var(--color-text); border-color: var(--color-border-strong); } .ds-tag[data-active="true"] { background: var(--color-accent); border-color: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-bg); } .ds-tag-count { margin-left: 8px; font-size: 0.68rem; opacity: 0.75; }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; object-fit: cover; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border); } .ds-card-body { padding: 20px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.05rem + 0.35vw, 1.25rem); font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-text); } .ds-card-date { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-text-secondary); } .ds-card-excerpt { margin: 0 0 16px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--color-text-secondary); } .ds-card-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Contact form field and textarea in Literata.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-text); } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--color-text); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-accent); outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring); outline-offset: 0; }

components.html: BlogAbout

components.name: Route Profile
components.description: Signature hero graphic: hairline baseline, three ticks, filled area, 2px route line, square waypoints.
components.css: .ds-profile { margin: 0; padding: 16px 16px 12px; background: var(--color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); } .ds-profile svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; } .ds-axis { stroke: var(--color-border-strong); stroke-width: 1; } .ds-tick { stroke: var(--color-border); stroke-width: 1; } .ds-fill { fill: var(--color-accent); opacity: 0.09; } .ds-line { fill: none; stroke: var(--color-accent); stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 620; stroke-dashoffset: 620; animation: ds-draw 1100ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards; } .ds-wp { fill: var(--color-surface); stroke: var(--color-accent); stroke-width: 2; } .ds-wp-now { fill: var(--color-sun); stroke: var(--color-text); } .ds-wp-2027 { fill: var(--color-reef); stroke: var(--color-text); } .ds-profile figcaption { margin-top: 12px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border); color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } @keyframes ds-draw { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-line { animation: none; stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }

narrative.overview: The site is a field guide for a move, not a travel brochure. It borrows the discipline of an expedition log: cool mist light, hairline rules, square waypoint markers, and a route profile that shows the journey in one glance. The three landscapes behind the identity are the Costa Rican canopy, the Belizean reef, and Italian limestone, which appear as the canopy green accent, the reef teal waypoint, and the sun-marked current position. Warmth is not the strategy here. The ground is intentionally cool, and the accents carry the climate: deep canopy green for action, reef teal and a single sun ochre for position. Headings are expedition signage in Archivo caps; prose is set in Literata for long reading. The only ornament is structural: rules, ticks, and a drawn route.
keyCharacteristics: Cool mist ground, basalt text, canopy green action.
Archivo caps for display and controls, Literata for reading.
Flat surfaces with hairline borders and 2px structural rules.
Square markers, not circles, for waypoints and the current stop.
One authored motion: the route profile draws once on load.

rules.name: The Cool Ground Rule
rules.body: The light background stays cool. Any warm near-white returns the site to the cluster it was rebuilt to escape.

rules.name: The One Action Color Rule
rules.body: Canopy marks what can be acted on. Reef and sun are for position and sequence only; if they appear on a control, the sequence is lying.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Archivo for anything that behaves like signage or a control; Literata for anything meant to be read at length. Do not set a paragraph in Archivo or a button in Literata.

rules.name: The Caps Budget Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for display, labels, and short headings. No uppercase body copy, no all-caps paragraphs.

dos: Do keep the light ground cool and the accents to their assigned roles.
Do verify contrast for body, meta, and text on accent fills in both themes.
Do keep every target at 44px, including wrapped chips and waypoints in the header.
Do use square markers for sequence and position.
Do let the route profile be the page's one drawn moment.
donts: Don't return to warm cream, beige, or terracotta.
Don't set headings in a system serif or body copy in the display face.
Don't add shadows, gradients, glass, or glow.
Don't use reef or sun for interactive text.
Don't round cards beyond 4px or turn markers into circles.
